recognize_zh: 低倍下可見淋巴結被膜與其下的被膜下竇，右側有一個淡染的次級濾泡生發中心，內含吞噬凋亡碎片的巨噬細胞（tingible body macrophage），其餘為帶有高內皮小靜脈的斑駁副皮質區，結構完整。
features: Thin fibrous capsule with subcapsular sinus along the top edge
Secondary follicle with a pale germinal center containing scattered tingible body macrophages (right)
A second ill-defined pale follicle-like area beneath the capsule (upper left)
Paracortex with a mottled appearance from pale histiocytes/dendritic cells and high endothelial venules
describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows an intact capsule and subcapsular sinus. The cortex contains a secondary follicle with a pale germinal center and scattered tingible body macrophages, while the underlying paracortex has a mottled appearance with high endothelial venules and interspersed pale cells. Nodal architecture is preserved, with no diffuse effacement or monotonous infiltrate. Findings are consistent with normal/reactive lymph node cortex and paracortex.

ddx.vs: FL shows crowded back-to-back follicles lacking tingible body macrophages and polarization, often extending through the capsule, whereas this node has few follicles with tingible body macrophages and a preserved paracortex.
Interfollicular Hodgkin lymphoma contains Reed-Sternberg/Hodgkin cells in a mixed inflammatory background, which should be sought at high power but are not evident here.
Paracortical hyperplasia expands the T zone with numerous immunoblasts and compresses follicles, a quantitative distinction requiring comparison with the whole node.
